title: SympFormer: Inertial Attention Blocks from Damped Hamiltonian Dynamics on Spaces of Probability Measures
abstract: arXiv:2610.31600v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The attention mechanism underpins modern large language models, yet their dynamics remain only partially understood. Recent perspectives interpret attention blocks as interacting particle systems, whose mean-field limits correspond to gradient flows of energy functionals on spaces of probability densities on $\mathbb R^d$ equipped with Wasserstein-type metrics. We extend this viewpoint by deriving accelerated attention blocks from inertial, Nesterov-type damped Hamiltonian dynamics on these density spaces, developing the geometry and differential calculus needed to make the construction rigorous. In particular, we introduce a local-mobility geometry for the Otto-Wasserstein and softmax-Wasserstein settings, and a quotient Stein geometry that resolves the degeneracy of the linear-attention kernel to yield a well-defined metric and differential calculus. We provide rigorous foundations when softmax attention admits a gradient-flow formul

translated_title: SympFormer：源自概率测度空间上阻尼哈密顿动力学的惯性注意力模块
translated_abstract: 注意力机制是现代大型语言模型的基石，但其动力学原理至今仍仅被部分理解。近期的观点将注意力模块解释为相互作用粒子系统，其平均场极限对应于配备 Wasserstein 型度量的 $\mathbb R^d$ 上概率密度空间中能量泛函的梯度流。我们拓展了这一视角，从这些密度空间上的惯性（Nesterov 型）阻尼哈密顿动力学中推导出加速注意力模块，并发展了使该构造严格化所需的几何与微分演算。特别地，我们为 Otto-Wasserstein 与 softmax-Wasserstein 情形引入了局部迁移率几何，并提出一种商 Stein 几何，解决了线性注意力核的退化问题，从而得到良定义的度量与微分演算。当 softmax 注意力允许梯度流形式时，我们给出了严格的数学基础。
tldr: 该论文提出 SympFormer，通过在概率密度空间上建立 Nesterov 型阻尼哈密顿动力学的几何框架（包括局部迁移率几何与商 Stein 几何），从动力学角度推导出具有加速特性的惯性注意力模块。
en_tdlr: SympFormer derives accelerated inertial attention blocks from Nesterov-type damped Hamiltonian dynamics on probability density spaces, introducing novel local-mobility and quotient Stein geometries to provide rigorous geometric foundations for attention mechanisms.
